sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Generated type references
sections.what: Points the project at Next.js type definitions for images and generated route types.
sections.why: Likely reason: Next.js needs these references for type checking to work.
sections.watch_out: Do not edit. Regenerate it by running the app.

summary: Generated type reference file that tells the editor and compiler about Next.js features.
purpose: Lets TypeScript understand Next.js types for images and routes.
why: Likely reason: Next.js creates it automatically so the project compiles without manual setup.
how: 1. Next.js writes this file. 2. TypeScript loads it through the tsconfig settings. 3. Nothing else reads it.
outputs: Type information only. Nothing runs from it.
risks: The file says not to edit it, and any edit is overwritten on the next build.
debug: If type errors mention Next.js types, run the dev or build command once to regenerate the file.
